title: Flower Dice
description:
Cultivate your garden & push your luck in Flower Dice. 

In Flower Dice, you'll be tasked with planting a garden of flowers and watering them. Be careful though! Your watering can is controlled by a dice. You're only able to water the entire row or column that the watering can has rolled. You'll need some strategy & luck to satisfy every flower in your garden.

Planting flowers isn't any easier. To maximise the point value of your garden you'll want to: consider the abilities of your flowers, what colour palettes suit them, and how much water they need.
description_short: Cultivate your garden & push your luck in Flower Dice. Focus on adjacency bonuses, like forming colour palettes, to maximise the point value of your garden. Each flower has unique abilities for endless builds.
